traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Cantrip
traits.description: Know one wizard cantrip of your choice; Intelligence is its spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Extra Language
traits.description: Speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

traits.name: Elf Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with longsword, shortsword, shortbow, and longbow.

traits.name: Fleet of Foot
traits.description: Base walking speed increases to 35 feet.

traits.name: Mask of the Wild
traits.description: Can attempt to hide even when only lightly obscured by foliage, heavy rain, falling snow, mist, and other natural phenomena.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight when the target/you are in direct sunlight.

traits.name: Drow Magic
traits.description: Know the Dancing Lights cantrip. At 3rd level, cast Faerie Fire once per long rest; at 5th level, also cast Darkness once per long rest. Charisma is the spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Drow Weapon Training
traits.description: Proficiency with rapiers, shortswords, and hand crossbows.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Hit point maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Dwarven Armor Training
traits.description: Proficiency with light and medium armor.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: Can attempt to hide even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Stout Resilience
traits.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Natural Illusionist
traits.description: Know the Minor Illusion cantrip; Intelligence is its spellcasting ability.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: Communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts, through gestures, sounds, and body language.

traits.name: Artificer's Lore
traits.description: Add twice your proficiency bonus to History checks related to magic items, alchemical objects, or technological devices.

traits.name: Tinker
traits.description: Proficiency with tinker's tools. Can spend 1 hour and 10gp of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP): a clockwork toy, fire starter, or music box.
